title: AOE skills hitting targets one by one ?

posts.author: Malbork
posts.body:
Hello everyone,
I want my multiple target skills to hit them one by one instead of all at once. (I want it for "all targets" and "random targets")
The same as Labyrinth of Refrain/Galleria, if you know them.
I think I can do it with Action Sequence plugin from VisuStella but I really don't know how to do it.
If someone could help me a bit, it would be very nice.
Thank you all.

posts.author: ramza
posts.body:
The VS action sequences plugin separates an attack into several phases. Setup, All Targets, Each Target, and finish.
Anything in the 'Each Target' section happens to each target of a multi-target attack, in sequence. You could make a cool AOE animation in the All Targets section first, then deal damage to each target in the each target section after.
